subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_diode_bias_generator ib_sink vdd
M6 ib_sink ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_diode_bias_generator
subcircuits.role_hint: Bias generation network using diode-connected PMOS M6; an external sink current at ib_sink establishes a PMOS gate bias voltage that biases the mirrored PMOS current source in the OTA core.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt complementary_differential_ota_core gnd ib_sink vdd vin vip vo
M2 net1 net2 gnd gnd nch l=ln_tail w=wn_tail m=1 nf=1
M1 vo vin net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M0 net2 vip net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M5 net3 ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
M4 vo vin net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
M3 net2 vip net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
.ends complementary_differential_ota_core
subcircuits.role_hint: Main complementary-input single-ended OTA core. M0/M1 form the NMOS differential input pair with NMOS tail device M2; M3/M4 form the PMOS differential input pair biased by PMOS current source M5. The node net2 is the internal reference-side drain node and also self-biases the NMOS tail device M2, while vo is the single-ended output.
